SOOPPIY DOCS — TRADING GATEWAY SETUP

Connect Interactive Brokers

How to create the API credentials at Interactive Brokers and connect them on the Accounts page. live trading available

1What you need

  • Client Portal Gateway URL
  • IBKR account id
Grant TRADE permission only — never withdrawal. Use the venue's IP allowlist when it offers one. Start small. Your keys are encrypted at rest (AES-GCM) on Sooppiy's server and are never shown again after you save them.

2Create your credentials at Interactive Brokers

  1. IBKR has no API key/secret here — the Client Portal Gateway session IS the credential. Download it from IBKR's website and run it on a machine Sooppiy's server can reach.
  2. Log in to the gateway in your browser (usually https://localhost:5000) with your IBKR username.
  3. Note your account id (e.g. DU1234567). Ids starting with D are paper accounts — shadow only works on a paper account.

3Connect it on the Accounts page

  1. Open Accounts → Trading gateway.
  2. Pick your region (ordering only — every broker stays available) and choose Interactive Brokers.
  3. Paste the credentials from step 2.
  4. Read and accept the live-trading terms — required even if you only plan to use shadow.
  5. Press Connect gateway. The account starts in paper mode: nothing is sent to Interactive Brokers yet.
  6. Switch the account to shadow (recommended first) or live on the account card.

4What each mode does with Interactive Brokers

ModeWhat happens
paperpaper / simulator — every trade stays on Sooppiy's internal ledger. Interactive Brokers is never contacted.
shadowshadow — fills stay simulated and the same order is ALSO sent to your IBKR paper account through the gateway; the drift is journalled.
livelive — real orders go to your Interactive Brokers account. The broker is authoritative: a rejected order never creates a platform position. Requires accepted terms and usable credentials; refusals are always explicit, never a silent simulation.
Whatever mode you use, the Broker orders and Drift records panels at the bottom of the Accounts page show what Interactive Brokers actually confirmed next to what the ledger assumed — differences are surfaced loudly, never auto-corrected.

5Venue notes

  • The gateway session expires after idle minutes. Sooppiy tickles it automatically and alerts you when it lapses — the health banner on the Accounts page shows the current state.
  • Only tick “self-signed certificate” for a gateway on your own machine or private network.

6Troubleshooting

SymptomWhat it means / what to do
“credentials are missing or cannot be decrypted”The stored key can no longer be read (for example after a server key rotation). Reconnect the broker with fresh credentials.
“live-trading terms have not been accepted”Accept the terms for this broker on the Accounts page — consent is recorded per broker.
“gateway session is not authenticated”Open the Client Portal Gateway in your browser and log in again — the session lapsed beyond what the keepalive could revive.
